cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before congratulating the winner, apologise for starting me behind the shed. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Yes. I spent the first ten seconds finding the race.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely opening. Add 'and that was unfair to you.'

mechanism: A negotiates an apology for an unfair race start, concedes the recorded placing and B innocent intent while requiring acknowledgment of disadvantage.
confusable: Unlike demanding the win or accusing cheating, A seeks apology naming the unfair starting condition.
comparison: Race placement and accidental starting position differ from a cake introduction biasing judges.
seedUse: D195-a shed, ten seconds and honest mistake; S02-a yields result and intent to keep apology cooperation.
